# GeoIP test databases

Small synthetic test databases from https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/main/test-data
(downloaded 2026-10-25), dual licensed under Apache-2.0 or MIT; see LICENSE-APACHE and LICENSE-MIT in this directory.

- country.mmdb: GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb
- city.mmdb: GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb
- asn.mmdb: GeoLite2-ASN-Test.mmdb

These are test-only fixtures and are not installed or distributed as production databases.
